title: Taiwan benchmark Taiex rises to record intraday high as tech stocks advance
summary: On September 22, 2026, Taiwan's benchmark Taiex index achieved a remarkable intraday high, primarily fueled by advancements in the technology sector. This surge followed a significant AI-driven rally observed on Wall Street, indicating a strong correlation between global market trends and local stock performance. Investors are increasingly optimistic about the potential of AI technologies, which are reshaping various industries and driving economic growth.
